description: Fetch numeric KPI values from Kolada for a specific indicator (kpiId), Swedish municipality or region (municipalityId), and year. Returns value rows broken down by gender: T=total, K=women (kvinnor), M=men (män); non-gendered KPIs return only T.municipalityId from list_municipalities. Returns values per gender ("T" total, "K" women, "M" men); non-gendered KPIs report only "T".
name: get_data
